Body.Content:
Customers using Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations for project-based expense management need taxes on intercompany expenses to be processed correctly and consistently, irrespective of whether intercompany tax posting is configured in the source or destination legal entity. This enhancement aims to provide predictable tax treatment across legal entities and reduce configuration-dependent inconsistencies during intercompany expense processing.

GA date: July CY2027

Preview date: March CY2027
